why.title: The phone is no longer enough
why.c1t: Bolt and Liftago are in your town too
why.c1b: Since spring 2026 Bolt takes orders anywhere in Czechia. Once a customer gets used to an app, they stop looking up your number.
why.c2t: The fleet in the next town already has one
why.c2b: Usually rented from a vendor, under the vendor's account, in the vendor's look. Yours will be yours: your colour, your logo, your number.
why.c3b: A marketplace takes a cut of every ride and sets the price. Regulars, the station run, fixed prices and airport trips are your edge. Keep it.
feat.title: One system, three apps
feat.sub: Customer, driver and dispatch work on the same orders in real time. Nothing is retyped, nothing gets lost.
p1.title: Order in three taps
p1.body: Open, pick a destination, order. The price shows up front – fixed or an estimate. The customer watches the car on the map, knows which car is coming and when, and rates the driver at the end.
p1.l1: Sign-in by SMS code, no password
p1.l2: Ride tracking without an account, via a link
p1.l3: Six languages incl. Ukrainian and Russian
p1.l4: Works on a cheap phone with weak signal
p1.l5: A Call button on every screen
p2.title: The driver sees only what matters now
p2.body: A full-screen ride offer with price and distance. One big button for every step: accept, arrived, start, finish. Navigation in one tap.
p2.l1: Fixed price pre-filled, changed only with a reason
p2.l4: Nothing to install, opens like an app
p2.l5: Picks up where it left off after a signal drop
p3.title: Cars, orders and map on one screen
p3.body: The dispatcher takes a phone order and assigns a car in seconds. App orders arrive on their own. The owner sees how the fleet did, who drove and what it cost.
p3.l1: Phone and app orders in one list
p3.l2: Fixed routes and zones: station – centre 100 Kč, set once
p3.l4: Every change is in the audit log
p3.l5: Dispatch opens in a browser, nothing to install
brand.title: Your colour, your logo, your number
brand.body: The app carries your fleet's name, not ours. Customers open it from a link or a home-screen icon – no app store, no waiting for approval. Light and dark mode.
how.title: How it works
how.s1b: We go through how you work today: how many cars, what prices, where.
how.s2b: Colour, logo, phone, fixed routes, drivers. Usually within a week.
how.s3b: Put the link on your website, business cards, SMS. You keep your phone number – it just rings less.
price.title: Priced by fleet size
price.body: One monthly amount for the whole fleet. The customer app is included. No per-driver licence, no commission on rides.
price.cta: Call us and we'll tell you the price for your fleet
price.l6: SMS and maps at cost, with a monthly cap you set
origin.title: Built for three cars in Kolín
origin.body: The system was built for Taxi Kolín, a family taxi service with three cars in Kolín and Kutná Hora that used to take every order by phone. We built it for ourselves first, then for others. That is why there is nothing in it a small fleet does not need.
origin.caption: Rides, ratings and operating numbers will follow as we collect them.
origin.routes: Fixed routes the fleet set once
faq.title: What owners ask
faq.a1: A marketplace owns the customer, sets the price and takes a cut. Your own app is yours: the price and the customer. You can still drive for them on the side.
faq.q2: It isn't in the App Store. Is that a problem?
faq.a2: The customer opens a link and adds an icon to the home screen – two taps. No approval queue, instant updates, and the app is under your name, not a vendor's account.
faq.a3: Not necessarily. App orders arrive on their own and the owner can assign cars from a laptop or tablet. If you have a dispatcher, they get a clear board instead of a notebook.
faq.a4: The customer sees a Call button and your number. The driver's ride is saved on the phone and continues once they reconnect.
faq.a5: Usually within a week of the call. We set colour, logo, phone, fixed routes and drivers; you hand out the link.
faq.a6: On servers in the EU, each fleet separated. You can download orders, customers and reports as CSV at any time.
faq.a7: Yes, any time. No fixed-term contract, and you take your data with you.
